name: Camille
title: the Steel Shadow

Q.name: Precision Protocol
Q.description: Camille's next Attack deals an additional tADRatio×AD physical damage and grants her 25/30/35/40/45% Move Speed for 1 second. This ability can be Recast in the next 3.5 seconds. If the Recast Attack hits at least 1.5 seconds after the first, the bonus damage is increased to (tADRatio×AD) × 2 and 0.4+ (by level) of the Attack's damage is converted into true damage. This Ability triggers spell effects upon dealing damage.
Q.summary: Camille's next attack deals bonus damage and grants bonus Move Speed. This spell can be recast for a short period of time, doing significantly increased bonus damage if Camille delays a period of time between the two attacks.

W.name: Tactical Sweep
W.description: Camille winds up and slices, dealing 60/85/110/135/160 + 0.6×bonus AD physical damage. Enemies hit by the outer half are Slowed by 80% decaying over 2 seconds, and they take an additional 0.07/0.075/0.08/0.085/0.09 + 0.0×bonus AD max Health physical damage. Camille restores 100% of the bonus damage dealt to champions as Health.
W.summary: Camille blasts in a cone after a delay, dealing damage. Enemies in the outer half are slowed and take extra damage, while also healing Camille.

E.name: Hookshot
E.description: Camille fires a hookshot that attaches to terrain, pulling her to it for 1 second and allowing this Ability to be Recast. Recast: Camille dashes from the wall, colliding with the first enemy champion hit. Upon landing, she gains 40/45/50/55.0/60% Attack Speed for 5 seconds, deals 60/90/120/150/180 + 0.75×bonus AD physical damage to nearby enemies, and Stuns enemy champions for 0.75 seconds. Dashes towards enemy champions travel twice as far.
E.summary: Camille pulls herself to a wall, leaping off and knocking up enemy champions upon landing.

R.name: The Hextech Ultimatum
R.description: Camille briefly becomes Untargetable and leaps onto an enemy champion, interrupting channels and locking them into an area they cannot escape by any means for 2.5/3.25/4 seconds. Other nearby enemies are Knocked Away. Her Attacks against the trapped enemy deal an additional 4/6/8% current Health magic damage.
R.summary: Camille dashes to target champion, anchoring them to the area. She also deals bonus magic damage to the target with her basic attacks.

Passive.name: Adaptive Defenses
Passive.description: Basic attacks on champions grant a shield equal to a percentage of Camille's maximum health against their damage type (Physical or Magic) for a brief duration.
Passive.summary: Basic attacks on champions grant a shield equal to a percentage of Camille's maximum health against their damage type (Physical or Magic) for a brief duration.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Precise duelist/assassin who trades with Q empowered attacks, dives with E hookshot (knock-up) and isolates with R.
strengths: Strong short trades with Q (true damage on charged Q2)
Passive shields against the target's damage type
weaknesses: E is telegraphed and needs a wall
Can be punished when E is down

curve.lvl1: weak – limited damage, passive shield only

profile.curveNote: Wants E before committing; Q charged + W outer edge are her trade.
profile.sustain: medium – W outer heal, passive shield

Passive.notes: Attacks on champions give a shield vs their damage type.

Q.notes: Empowered attack; recast after delay converts to true damage.

W.notes: Cone after delay; outer half slows, heals.

E.notes: Hook to a wall, dash; knocks up champions on landing (stun in older versions: check).

R.notes: Untargetable while leaping in; zone that keeps target in.

profile.windowAgainst: E down: she can't engage or escape.
checks: E landing: knock-up vs stun: check
